context_documents.title: 2024-1323 · A low pivot and controlled note tunnel protect shot repeatability
context_documents.body:
# 2024-1323: A low pivot and controlled note tunnel protect shot repeatability

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

A full-width under-bumper collector uses independently driven lateral funneling into a protected ramp/tunnel. The retained source record describes a low rear launcher pivot with separate left/right shooting groups and the same assembly serving amp delivery.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The interview emphasizes preserving a continuous note journey and designing for high-level strategic options early. It does not establish that every apparent feature was added specifically for one later playoff tactic.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

A low tunnel can limit note bending and moving mass, but a protective cover also needs to avoid becoming a new trapping surface. Separately powered funneling allows transport behavior to be tuned without forcing the ground pickup to the same speed. The useful reference is a consistent note state at release; a compact exterior alone does not establish that consistency.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Test note distortion, off-center entry and cover clearances with worn notes. Compare shot variation after aggressive collection and after gentle hand placement to isolate transport effects.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.

source_reviews.title: FIRST 2024 team record
facts: The season register calls the robot ETR19.
source_reviews.limitations: The name is reused in other seasons and does not identify a mechanism revision.

source_reviews.title: Behind the Bumpers introduction
facts: The linked episode presents the 2024 MadTown robot and covers iterations.
source_reviews.limitations: Introductory copy gives no measured or construction detail.

source_reviews.title: 1323 Behind the Bumpers
source_reviews.review_basis: Inherited synopsis only. Video page returned no captions.
facts: The corpus describes an under-bumper pickup with independently powered lateral funneling, a printed ramp, a low pivoted launcher and gas-strut-assisted chain hardware.
source_reviews.limitations: No new caption or physical audit.

source_review.whole_robot_explanation: The dossier describes a broad pickup feeding a much narrower aiming and launch assembly. That gives the driver freedom to approach a note off-center, provided the funnel can deliver the rim straight and at repeatable speed. The low launcher pivot and frame plates make this a packaging case as much as a launcher case. The support plates, transfer and endgame hardware all compete for the space behind the leading bumper.
piece_flow: A wide under-bumper capture region admits the note.
Lateral contacts push it toward the center and a printed ramp leads it toward the launch assembly.
The inherited account describes a low-distortion passage, independent left/right launcher contacts and a shared pivot assembly for amp delivery.
source_review.packaging_and_motion: An inset pickup has to retain usable floor clearance at realistic bumper heights, during braking and with the belly close to carpet. Moving the shooter pivot toward the floor can reduce the height and moving mass moment, but it tightens clearance between the shooter entrance, tunnel and structure. Check this with a note in the mechanism and through both commanded poses.

subsystems.name: Collector, funnel and passage
subsystems.construction: Older dossier describes a full-width under-bumper pickup, powered lateral centering and printed ramp.
subsystems.operation: Capture edge arrivals and present the note to the launcher at the center.
subsystems.team_rationale: The inherited account describes preserving the note shape ahead of the shooter.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: Increasing transverse speed may center quickly or cause a sideways arrival if the following roller takes the rim too early. A small centering error can become different exit yaw when the two wheel groups load unevenly.
subsystems.interfaces: Bumper opening, ramp entrance, side-roller traction and the first constrained throat.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Proposed checks are left/right edge pickup, dented note reversal and ramp access with bumpers installed.
subsystems.unknowns: Actual surface speeds, ramp material and detection logic.

subsystems.name: Launcher and chain interface
subsystems.construction: Inherited low-pivot launcher with separately driven wheel groups. Dossier also describes gas-strut deployment and a winch.
subsystems.operation: Aim at speaker, reposition for amp and deploy the chain hardware for endgame.
subsystems.team_rationale: Older dossier attributes launcher speed asymmetry to flight stability.
subsystems.engineering_analysis: The intake establishes initial conditions for the shot. Compare equal and unequal wheel commands with controlled note skew, then test whether a side-plate repair preserves both pivot and feeder alignment.
subsystems.interfaces: The pivot, frame supports and winch need space and service access. Chain load can pull the same structure that locates the launcher.
subsystems.service_and_failure_modes: Proposed check is full loaded travel and mounting repeatability after replacing a side plate or pivot support.
subsystems.unknowns: Launch settings, chain hardware load path and revision boundaries.

revisions: Inherited dossier points to the Championship package. Earlier installed states are unresolved.
transferable_principles: Measure the entire wide-to-narrow path with representative notes. Compare shot dispersion at equal travel time and throughput, including edge pickups.
disconfirming_conditions: A narrow receiver, stiff piece, low allowable bumper opening or limited debris access can make this path slower than a smaller but cleaner capture envelope.
remaining_gaps: Direct caption read or season build records, note sensor positions, pivot coordinates, launcher setpoints and loaded chain path.
